entities.summary: Emil Galimov is a Russian professional ice hockey player of Tatar descent. He is currently playing with Barys Astana of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Galimov was selected by the San Jose Sharks in the 7th round of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
